author: claude
summary: Design-critique follow-up (H-1, H-2, H-3 partial) plus one owner decision on the voice-detail page: (1) VoiceDetailHeader's 5 equal-weight action buttons are consolidated into a single overflow ActionMenu (Set default/Export/Publish, divider, Delete), matching VoiceCatalogCard's ordering convention; (2) the header's redundant 'Play preview' control is dropped entirely (per-variant audition already covered by VariantSwitcher rows and VariantEditor); (3) voice delete now routes through requestConfirm/ConfirmModal instead of window.confirm; (4) the Overview disclosure's default open/collapsed state is now computed once per voice from metadata completeness (open only when class/gender/age is missing) instead of always-open, and does not fight a user's manual toggle on metadata refresh.

files.change: Removed the Play preview button and its usePlayerBus/loadAndPlay/pause wiring (now-unused previewUrl/isPlaying/handlePreview also removed). Replaced the 4 remaining action buttons (Set default, Export, Publish, Delete) with a single `ActionMenu` (items array: Set default, Export bundle, Publish, divider, Delete as isDestructive) reusing the existing `@/components/ui/ActionMenu` component per VoiceCatalogCard's pattern.

Voice-delete's onDelete handler now calls requestConfirm({ title, message, isDestructive: true, onConfirm: handleDelete }) instead of window.confirm(...). Added overviewOpen state + a one-time-per-voice-id init effect (guarded by a ref) that sets the Overview disclosure's default open state from metadata completeness (attrs.class/gender/age, mirroring OverviewTab's requiredMissing check); the <details> element is now controlled (open={overviewOpen}, onToggle updates state) so a later metadata refresh for the same voice doesn't re-force the user's manual expand/collapse.

Updated the always-open disclosure test to reflect metadata-completeness-driven defaults; added tests for collapsed-by-default (complete metadata), open-by-default (missing required field), and no-force-reopen-after-manual-collapse. Updated the Publish-to-Hugging-Face test to open the header's overflow menu first. Added a 'header overflow menu' describe block: Play preview absent, all 4 actions reachable via the single overflow menu, and delete routes through the themed ConfirmModal (spies confirm window.confirm is never called, and that DELETE fetch fires after confirming).
